prompt: A gift box is a cube with edges of $4$ inches. How much wrapping paper covers its outside exactly, with no overlap?
hint: A cube has $6$ identical square faces.

hints.text: A cube has $6$ identical square faces.

explanation: Surface area counts every face: a cube has $6$ of them.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sort out the near misses
steps: $16$ is one face only; $24$ comes from $6 \times 4$, multiplying the six faces by the EDGE instead of by the face area; and $64$ is the VOLUME, $4^3$ — what fits inside, not what covers it.
Wrapping paper is a covering, so it is measured in square inches and needs all six faces: $96$.
